title: I'm redesigning the UI for my dark-fantasy dungeon crawler. Which version feels more appropriate, A or B?
author: thvaz
selftext:
I'm currently polishing the demo for Submundus and I've been reworking the gameplay UI.

The original version is intentionally very minimal, but I felt it was starting to look a bit too much like prototype/debug UI.

The redesign gives the cards, deck/discard panels and survival resources a much stronger visual frame, but a few people I've shown it to felt the angular shapes and yellow accents push it too far toward sci-fi rather than dark fantasy.

I'm a bit too close to it at this point, so I'd love some fresh eyes:

**Which one would you choose, and what specifically makes the other one feel wrong?**

[Current](https://preview.redd.it/gd72aqz4mymh1.png?width=1672&format=png&auto=webp&s=45e7a56cddbe20bdf07660045639ab19603eb63e)

[Concept](https://preview.redd.it/x86fkqz4mymh1.png?width=1668&format=png&auto=webp&s=c3f28c26e59ccb5e263e0c582f8118548a5f3f75)

comments.author: Cork20
comments.body: The scale and contrast are the more obvious differences which make the second option easier to read
